About Us

Rwanda's Trusted Tech Partner

OfficeHomeTechX Ltd is a Rwandan technology service and skills development company founded in 2025, based in Nyarugenge, Kigali. We provide practical IT training and reliable technical services to empower youth and businesses.

Our integrated model trains young people in hands-on tech skills, then deploys them as verified, professional technicians — delivering fast, affordable service to homes, offices, schools, and NGOs across Kigali.

We address two critical challenges: unreliable tech support for households and SMEs, and youth unemployment due to lack of market-ready skills. We solve both at once.
